Signature technology

Four wavelengths, four depths

All four in a single shot

Each wavelength reaches a different depth of the follicle. Combined, they cover skin types I to VI and every hair thickness — so you treat every client with the same machine.

755 nm · Alexandrite

Strongly absorbed by melanin: precise on light skin and on fine, light hair.

808 nm · Diode

The classic diode wavelength. The best balance between depth and absorption — effective on every skin type.

940 nm · Infrared

Reaches deeper, to the bulb and the vessels that feed the follicle, to limit regrowth from the root.

1064 nm · Nd:YAG

The deepest and the gentlest on the melanin of the epidermis — the safest choice for darker skin.

Non-crystal

No crystal: the energy lands where it should

In traditional handpieces the light passes through a glass crystal, where the beam spreads and loses energy before it reaches the skin. The non-crystal handpiece emits straight from the laser bars through focusing lenses: the beam stays dense and even down to the follicle, and the handpiece is smaller and lighter in the hand.

Traditional · the energy spreadsNon-crystal · the energy reaches the follicle

DERMATECH HIFU

Lifting and tightening without a scalpel

High-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) reaches a precise depth beneath the skin — down to the SMAS layer, the same layer a surgical facelift works on. The heat at the focal points contracts the collagen and triggers new collagen, for firmer, lifted skin on the face, neck and body — no incisions and no downtime.

Face liftingJawlineNeckForehead & eye linesBody tighteningNo downtime
Quote for the HIFU→
How it works

Three depths, one target: collagen

1.5 mm · Superficial dermis

For fine lines and skin texture — around the eyes, on the forehead and wherever the skin is thin.

3.0 mm · Deep dermis

Firmness and elasticity: the heat tightens the collagen network that holds the skin.

4.5 mm · SMAS layer

The deepest facial layer, the one a surgical facelift works on: lifting and a sharper contour of cheeks, jawline and neck. For the body, the 6.0, 9.0 and 13.0 mm cartridges go deeper still.

  1. FocusThe ultrasound passes through the skin and focuses at the chosen depth.
  2. Heat pointsTiny points at 60–70 °C, with the skin surface untouched.
  3. Instant tighteningThe collagen fibres contract — a first lift right after the session.
  4. New collagenThe skin builds new collagen; the result shows gradually over 1–3 months.
Two handpieces

Purchase or leasing — which one suits me?

With a purchase the machine is yours from the first day, at the lowest total cost over the years. With leasing you pay a monthly instalment for an agreed period, without tying up capital, and the machine pays for itself through the treatments. Either way, we service it for you.

Does it work on every skin type?

Yes. The four wavelengths (755, 808, 940, 1064 nm) cover skin types I to VI — from very light to very dark skin — and every hair thickness.

Does laser hair removal hurt?

The compressor cooling keeps the head between 0 and −30 °C, so the client feels cold rather than heat. The treatment is practically painless.

What is HIFU and when does the result show?

HIFU sends focused ultrasound to a set depth beneath the skin — 1.5 to 4.5 mm on the face, up to 13 mm on the body — where the heat tightens the collagen. A first lift can be seen right after the session; the main result comes gradually over 1–3 months as new collagen forms. A repeat every 6–12 months is usually recommended.

Does HIFU hurt?

Most clients feel warmth and a light prickling, depending on the energy, the area and their own sensitivity. There is no downtime: the client goes straight back to their day.

How long does a handpiece last?

Each handpiece of the Diode Laser 4λ is rated for 100 million shots. The heads are interchangeable.

What warranty do the machines have?

The DERMATECH Diode Laser 4λ comes with a 3-year warranty. We give you the warranty terms of the 5-in-1 and the HIFU with your quote.

How long does a session take?

Indicatively: underarms 3–5 minutes each, face 6–8, bikini 4–6, abdomen 9–15, arms 12–16, a leg 16–20 minutes.

Who should not have laser treatment?

Treatment is avoided in cases such as:

  • recent or upcoming sun exposure
  • photosensitive skin or photosensitising medication
  • recent isotretinoin use
  • pregnancy
  • severe diabetes, hypertension or heart disease
  • history of keloids, or suspected skin cancer
  • infection on the treatment area
What do I need for the installation?

A 220 V socket and about half a metre of space behind the machine for ventilation. The Diode Laser 4λ measures about 111 × 41 × 47 cm and weighs 56 kg, on wheels.
